jobs.title: Flight Test Engineer (All genders)
jobs.description: At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. WHY JOIN US The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. ABOUT THE TEAM STARK is a European defence technology company building the next generation of unmanned systems. You will join our dynamic Flight Operations team dedicated to demonstrating, testing, and deploying high-performance autonomous platforms. In this role, you will bridge the gap between engineering development, flight testing, and high-visibility field operations across national and international settings. YOUR MISSION Your mission is to fly our multirotor platforms flawlessly under real-world, high-visibility conditions, at home in Germany and internationally, showcasing product capabilities to internal stakeholders, partners, and customers. WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK Execute precision demonstration flights of multirotor systems during live customer presentations and operational trials. Conduct rigorous flight testing of hardware, firmware, and software updates in controlled and field environments. Manage flight planning, risk assessments, airspace clearances, and regulatory compliance for all flight operations. Deploy nationally and internationally to support high-stakes field trials, trade shows, and customer demonstrations. Perform pre-flight inspections, system checks, and post-flight data collection to ensure airworthiness and safety. Collaborate with engineering teams to provide structured flight logs, technical feedback, and operational performance insights. Maintain flight safety standards, emergency protocols, and continuous improvement procedures for all mission profiles.
